entwurf.thema: Using Claude projects to prepare a checklist guide you might sell as a PDF

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Nobody buys a messy, half-finished guide. Imagine your checklist PDF scattered across a dozen Claude chats and loose notes.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: black-haired man in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a cluttered desk, frowning at scattered handwritten pages, medium shot, moody neon evening light.

teile.name: Frage
teile.text: But the writing isn't the problem. Say you sell a checklist guide. Where does Claude keep all your notes?
teile.szene: Painted urban game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket sorts loose pages into neat stacks on a workshop table, close-up on hands, warm lamp light, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Projects
teile.text: Projects hold their own chat histories and knowledge bases. You upload documents, provide context, and have focused chats.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center page on projects, showing the description of self-contained workspaces with their own chat histories and knowledge bases.

teile.name: Plans
teile.text: Free accounts can make five projects. Usage limits apply.
teile.szene: Official Claude Help Center page on projects, showing the line that projects are available to all users and that free users can create a maximum of five projects.

teile.name: Test
teile.text: So what comes first? Spend time defining your success criteria.
teile.szene: Claude Platform Docs prompt engineering overview page, showing the lines about a clear definition of the success criteria for your use case.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: So your scattered checklist guide gets one home for notes and one clear standard. No income is promised.
teile.szene: Painted open-world-game poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket smiles with relief, holding a neat finished stack of pages in a bright workshop, medium shot, warm light.

teile.name: Ende
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted urban game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in black leather jacket gives a friendly nod beside a tidy desk at dusk, medium shot, neon glow, calm space for overlays.

entwurf.beschreibung: How Claude projects can hold your documents and chats while you prepare a checklist guide, and why defining success criteria comes first. Details come from Claude's official pages; no income is promised.
